messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to push releasewave-3 at 02:00 UTC. This covers API v3.2, runtime 1.9.0, console dashboard update and router v2.4.1. Need metric gates and fallback plan from everyone.
liam: ack. I will pin router v2.4.1 for the entire wave. Canary at 10% traffic, then 50% after 15m if metrics are green.
dina: noted. Proposing metric gating: p50 latency (api) < 250ms, error_rate < 0.25% over 10m. If either breaches for 5m, trigger fallback to router v2.3.8 and scale down canary.
sylvie: console will hold feature flags behind the flag "releasewave3_ui" — we won't flip until post-50% traffic. Will watch dashboard errors.
devon: runtime: enabling continuous batching improvements in 1.9.0. Added a safety knob to revert quantization path via env var. If memory OOMs or kvcache churn spikes > 20%, roll runtime back to 1.8.x.
maya: sounds good. Clarify rollback criteria: which team calls the rollback? ops on call should coordinate.
dina: ops-bot should own immediate cut if metrics hit critical. I propose automatic fallback (limited) for router only, and manual rollback for runtime and api.
ops-bot: auto-fallback rules loaded: {"router": {"error_rate_pct": 0.5, "window_s": 300}, "api": {"p95_latency_ms": 800, "window_s": 300}} — auto actions require ops-approved escalation after execution.
liam: example commands ready: `deploybot promote --wave releasewave-3 --percent 50` and `deploybot rollback --wave releasewave-3 --service router --to v2.3.8`.
deploy-bot: deploybot: starting wave-3 canary at 02:00 UTC -> router v2.4.1 (10%), api v3.2 (10%), runtime 1.9.0 (10%), console (ui flag off). Watch /deploybot status.
sylvie: release notes snippet for SE: "releasewave-3: router speedups, runtime batching improvements, API schema extension for structured outputs. Feature flag 'releasewave3_ui' gated." I'll post to #release-notes after go/no-go.
devon: preflight checklist done: smoke tests passed in staging, kv cache eviction test green, runtime mem baseline within 2% of target.
maya: final call: canary window length 20m, telemetry check at 10m and 18m. If green, proceed to 50%. If any gating breach at any point, hold and escalate.
dina: add telemetry gating for downstream console errors: console ui error rate < 0.1% and Sentry regressions none.
liam: pinned router cluster will keep old variant around as hot fallback; we won't drain connections until 5m after fallback completes.
maya: agreed. Post-deploy actions: 1) flip canary percent 50 -> wait 15m; 2) run smoke queries against pinned datasets; 3) enable console flag after 50% stable.
sylvie: posting release notes now: https://internal.releases/redwood/releasewave-3 (draft).
ops-bot: alerting rota for the window: oncall=dina, backup=devon, escalation=liam. Pager duty channel: #oncall.
liam: small nit — add a metric gating for model-compat mismatch: if output-rr (rerank rate) drops > 10% vs baseline for 15m, pause traffic.
dina: acknowledged. Adding anomaly rule.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary progressed to 50% (timestamp 5912349905). Monitoring pipelines live.
maya: monitoring summary at +10m: api p50 210ms, error_rate 0.12%, router error_rate 0.05%, runtime kvcache churn 3% — looks good so far.
liam: confirmed. Proceed to remaining 100% in staged waves per runbook unless any regressions.
ops-bot: auto-fallback triggered? no.
sylvie: will flip UI flag after 15m from now once we have two stable checks.
maya: if anything looks off: call rollback with `deploybot rollback --wave releasewave-3 --all` and notify #eng-releases and #oncall.
dina: if rollback needed, we follow postmortem template and lock any config flips for 24h.
maya: thanks all — keeping this thread for final disposition. Remember to update release-notes and tag customers on the docs channel if we do any rollback.
